finding.summary: 论文声称框架可纳入任意 sparsity-aware 技术；实验路径既未执行 specialization，其可达代码也只有固定模板枚举，无外部内核纳入能力。

paper.quote: SparTA’s specialization framework is general to incorporate any sparsity-aware techniques, including the off-the-shelf sparse kernel and even its dense version.

analysis.tier_note: the probes confirm what the Finding says
analysis.reasoning: The cited transform_matmul has the specialize_matmul loop inside a triple-quoted block, so specialization is not executed and best_kernels remains None. The reachable codegen only selects dense, fine-grained, or block-sparse templates based on dismantle values. No path accepts an external sparsity-aware kernel, supporting the claimed implementation deviation.
analysis.would_confirm: Run transform_matmul on any TeSA and verify whether specialize_matmul is ever invoked and whether any non-template external kernel can be selected.
